description:
## Problem
`Fetcher#fetch` eagerly resolves DNS for the initial URL's host before entering `fetch_loop`. If the URL is already cached, this DNS resolution is wasted. For a library fetching thousands of URLs where many are cached, this adds unnecessary DNS traffic and latency.

## File
- `src/vug/fetcher.cr` (lines 144-150)

## Fix
Move DNS resolution to after the cache check in `fetch_loop`, or into `fetch_single` where it's actually needed for DNS rebinding detection.

## Acceptance
- No DNS resolution on cache hits
- DNS rebinding detection still works correctly
- Existing tests pass
title: Defer eager DNS resolution in Fetcher#fetch to avoid wasted lookups on cache hits
